Regulation: B.C. Reg. 140/2026
Made under: Recall And Initiative Act
Published in: No. 14 – B.C. Regs. 125 to 148, July 28, 2026
Deposit date: July 21, 2026

B.C. Reg. 140/2026, deposited July 21, 2026, under theRECALL AND INITIATIVE ACT[section 171 (3)]. Regulation of the Chief Electoral Officer, dated July 20, 2026. I, Shipra Verma, order that the Advertising Sponsor Disclosure Report Regulation, B.C. Reg. 8/2001, is repealed and the attached Advertising Sponsor Disclosure Report Regulation is made. — S. VERMA,Chief Electoral Officer. ADVERTISING SPONSOR DISCLOSUREREPORT REGULATION 1In this regulation,"Act"means theRecall and Initiative Act. Initiative advertising disclosure report 2(1)	For the purposes of section 101 of the Act, the form of initiative advertising disclosure report set out in the Schedule and titled "Initiative Advertising Sponsor Disclosure Report" is prescribed. (2)	Each initiative advertising disclosure report filed under section 100 (4) of the Act as a supplementary report must include information that does the following: (a)	in the case of a first supplementary report, identifies the report as "Amendment #1"; (b)	in the case of a further supplementary report, identifies the report as a sequentially numbered amendment. Classes of initiative advertising and recall advertising 3(1)	For the purposes of section 101 (1) (a) of the Act, the value of initiative advertising must be reported according to the following classes of advertising: (a)	printed newspapers and periodicals; (b)	promotional materials, including newsletters, brochures, buttons and novelty items; (h)	online other than social media; (i)	other forms of advertising. (2)	For the purposes of section 148 (1) (a) of the Act, the value of recall advertising must be reported according to the following classes of advertising: (a)	commercial canvassing in person or by telephone; (b)	printed newspapers and periodicals; (c)	promotional materials, including newsletters, brochures, buttons and novelty items;

minutes_briefs.title: BC Replaces Advertising Sponsor Disclosure Report Regulation for Recall and Initiative Campaigns
minutes_briefs.summary: BC's Chief Electoral Officer has repealed and replaced the Advertising Sponsor Disclosure Report Regulation (B.C. Reg. 8/2001) under the Recall and Initiative Act. The new regulation, B.C. Reg. 140/2026, sets the required form for an initiative advertising disclosure report and requires supplementary reports to be labelled as numbered amendments (Amendment #1, then #2, and so on). It also lists the classes of advertising — such as newspapers, promotional materials, and online ads — that sponsors must use when reporting the value of initiative and recall advertising.
minutes_briefs.action_required: If you sponsor or pay for advertising in a BC recall or initiative campaign, use the new prescribed disclosure report form and label any supplementary reports as numbered amendments.
